mapper.select: SELECT product_id, category_id, title, url, product_code, description, base_price, is_active, brand, [condition], default_image, [status], create_at, update_at, create_by, update_by, view_count FROM products

SELECT -- 1. Các cột của bảng cha (Products) p.product_id, p.category_id, p.title, p.url, p.product_code, p.description, p.base_price, p.is_active, p.brand, p.[condition], p.default_image, p.[status], p.create_at, p.update_at, p.create_by, p.update_by, p.view_count,
-- 2. Các cột của bảng con (Variants) - Đặt Alias khớp với ResultMap pv.variant_id AS v_variant_id, pv.color AS v_color, pv.size AS v_size, pv.price AS v_price, pv.stock_qty AS v_stock_qty, pv.image AS v_image, pv.product_variant_code AS v_code
FROM products p -- LEFT JOIN để lấy cả biến thể. Nếu sản phẩm chưa có biến thể nào vẫn hiện ra info sản phẩm. LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.product_id = pv.product_id
WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (category_id, title, url, product_code, description, base_price, is_active, brand, [condition], default_image, [status], create_at, update_at, create_by, update_by, view_count) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{url}, #{productCode}, #{description}, #{basePrice}, #{isActive}, #{brand}, #{condition}, #{defaultImage}, #{status}, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, url = #{url}, product_code = #{productCode}, description = #{description}, base_price = #{basePrice}, is_active = #{isActive}, brand = #{brand}, [condition] = #{condition}, default_image = #{defaultImage}, [status] = #{status}, update_at = GETDATE(), update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND [status] = 'selling' -- Trong SQL bạn insert là 'selling' chứ không phải 'active' ORDER BY view_count DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.* FROM products p INNER JOIN ( SELECT pv.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_sold FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN product_variants pv ON oi.variant_id = pv.variant_id INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.[status] IN ('DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY pv.product_id ) sales ON p.product_id = sales.product_id ORDER BY sales.total_sold DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.*, ISNULL(sales.total_sold, 0) as total_sold FROM products p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pv.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_sold FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN product_variants pv ON oi.variant_id = pv.variant_id INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.[status] IN ('DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY pv.product_id ) sales ON p.product_id = sales.product_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 ORDER BY total_sold DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) FROM products p INNER JOIN product_variants pv ON p.product_id = pv.product_id INNER JOIN order_items oi ON pv.variant_id = oi.variant_id INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.[status] IN ('DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED') AND p.is_active = 1
SELECT * FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND (brand LIKE N'%' + #{keyword} + N'%' OR title LIKE N'%' + #{keyword} + N'%') ORDER BY create_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND (brand LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' OR title LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%')
